whoItsFor: Developers building React and Tailwind interfaces on shadcn/ui who want a consistent glass-like visual style, especially for AI and agent applications. It is installed as a stylesheet on top of an existing shadcn/ui project.
useCases: Styling a shadcn/ui project with a consistent surface, border, and shadow system in light and dark modes
Building agent interfaces with status lines, tool-step lists, diffs, and composer boxes
Adding AI-specific components such as context-usage rings, task notices, and reasoning panels

requirements.runtime: shadcn/ui project with React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4
